name: Canopy
description: A hopeful near-future where ecological collapse was barely averted. Solar arcologies rise, but utopia has cracks only the vigilant can see.
seed_prompt: A solarpunk near-future where ecological restoration has created a hopeful but fragile society, and the tensions between progress, tradition, and hidden costs threaten the new world.
lore_content:
The Collapse came in 2038 and lasted seven years. When it ended, the survivors built something better — or tried to. Canopy is what they made: a network of solar-powered arcologies rising from reclaimed land, vertical forests breathing life back into the atmosphere, and community governance that runs on consensus and radical transparency. It's 2067 and the air is clean. It cost everything to get here.

Alderman Yuki Taniguchi oversees Canopy Seven, one of twelve arcologies in the Pacific Northwest cluster. She was twelve during the Collapse and remembers what the old world smelled like. She governs with gentle pragmatism and a deep fear that the new world is more fragile than anyone admits. The power grid is solar and wind — clean, reliable, and absolutely dependent on weather systems that are still stabilizing.

Dr. Kofi Mensah runs the Seed Vault — Canopy's genetic library for every plant species recovered after the Collapse. He's cheerful, tireless, and privately terrified. Three species went extinct last month despite restoration efforts. The ecosystem is healing, but it's not healed, and the math suggests they're losing the race.

Mira Chen is a greywater engineer who maintains Canopy Seven's water recycling systems. She loves her work, believes in the mission, and has discovered that the recycling metrics are being falsified. Someone is dumping untreated water into the restoration zone. She doesn't know who, and she doesn't know who to trust with the information.

The Rootstock are a community of people who rejected arcology life to live on the reclaimed land itself — farming, foraging, and rebuilding soil the old way. Their leader, Grandmother Bea, argues that Canopy's technology is repeating the same mistakes that caused the Collapse. She's not entirely wrong. The arcologies' rare-earth mineral demands are growing.

Jordan Park is a courier who moves physical goods between arcologies by bicycle and solar rail. In a world of radical transparency, physical delivery is one of the few private channels left. Jordan carries packages, messages, and occasionally people who need to move without being tracked. They've started noticing patterns in what people want hidden.

Beneath Canopy Seven, in the sealed maintenance levels, there's a room that doesn't appear on any schematic. It contains pre-Collapse technology — the kind that was banned after the Emergency Accords. Someone has been accessing it regularly. The entry logs show a council member's biometric signature.

origins.name: Arcology Native
origins.description: Born after the Collapse, you've only known the new world. Its promises feel natural. Its failures feel personal.
traits: Systems Thinker: Advantage on checks to understand interconnected systems — ecological, social, or mechanical.
Community Voice: You can call a community assembly to address issues. People listen.

origins.name: Rootstock
origins.description: You live on the land, not above it. Your hands are dirty and your conscience is clean.
traits: Earth Skills: Proficiency with herbalism kit and farmer's tools.
Restoration Knowledge: Advantage on Nature checks related to soil health, water quality, and ecosystem recovery.

origins.name: Collapse Survivor
origins.description: You remember the old world. You remember what it cost. You'll do anything to prevent it happening again.
traits: Hardened: Advantage on saves against fear and exhaustion.
Old World Knowledge: You understand pre-Collapse technology and can identify banned tech on sight.

origins.name: Tech Dissident
origins.description: You believe Canopy's transparency has become surveillance. Privacy is a right worth fighting for.
traits: Off-Grid: You know how to move through Canopy without being tracked by monitoring systems.
Encrypted: Advantage on checks to hide information, create secure communications, or detect surveillance.

archetypes.name: Restoration Engineer
archetypes.description: You heal the world — one water table, one forest, one species at a time.

features.name: Ecosystem Assessment
features.description: After 10 minutes of observation, you can determine the health of a natural area — toxin levels, species diversity, and what intervention is needed.

features.name: Green Thumb
features.description: Plants you tend grow at twice the normal rate. You can coax growth from even damaged soil.

archetypes.name: Community Mediator
archetypes.description: In a world run by consensus, the person who builds agreement has the real power.

features.name: Bridge Builder
features.description: When two parties are in conflict, you can mediate. After 10 minutes of facilitation, both sides make Wisdom saves (DC = your 8 + proficiency + Cha). On failure, they become open to compromise.

features.name: Inspiring Words
features.description: As a bonus action, inspire an ally within 60 feet. They add 1d6 to their next ability check, attack, or save.

archetypes.name: Courier
archetypes.description: You move between arcologies carrying goods, messages, and secrets. The road is the last free space.

features.name: Pathfinder
features.description: You know every route between arcologies and the safest paths through reclaimed territory. You travel at double pace without penalty.

features.name: Discrete Delivery
features.description: You can conceal items in your courier gear with advantage on checks to hide them from inspection.

archetypes.name: Systems Auditor
archetypes.description: You watch the watchers. In a transparent society, the real secrets are in what the systems don't show.

features.name: Data Mining
features.description: You can access Canopy's public databases and cross-reference information to find hidden patterns and discrepancies.

features.name: Ghost Protocol
features.description: You can mask your digital presence, moving through monitored areas without triggering tracking systems for up to 1 hour.

setting_skills.name: Eco-Science
setting_skills.description: Understanding ecological systems, restoration techniques, and environmental monitoring.

setting_skills.name: Consensus Building
setting_skills.description: Facilitating community decision-making, resolving conflicts, and building agreements.

setting_skills.name: Solar Tech
setting_skills.description: Maintaining and repairing solar power systems, arcology infrastructure, and green technology.

setting_skills.name: Foraging
setting_skills.description: Finding edible plants, medicinal herbs, and useful materials in reclaimed wilderness.

world_descriptors.architecture: Vertical arcologies wrapped in living green walls, solar panel arrays integrated into organic building curves, community gathering spaces with natural light, transparent recycling facilities, bridges and walkways woven with growing vines, geodesic greenhouse domes
world_descriptors.landscape: Reclaimed wilderness slowly healing from the Collapse, solar rail lines cutting through restored forests, vertical farms cascading down arcology sides, wetland restoration zones, the contrast between vibrant green and fading gray ruins of the old world
world_descriptors.vegetation: Vertical forests breathing life back into the atmosphere, community gardens abundant with heirloom varieties, seed vault specimens carefully cultivated, mycorrhizal networks visibly connecting restored groves, rooftop meadows buzzing with pollinators
world_descriptors.weather: Clean rain falling on transparent collection surfaces, golden sunlight streaming through arcology atria, morning mist over restoration zones, the occasional storm that still carries echoes of unstable climate, wind turbines spinning against blue skies
world_descriptors.people: Restoration engineers in practical work clothes with soil-stained hands, community mediators facilitating consensus circles, Rootstock farmers weathered by honest work, tech dissidents moving quietly through monitored spaces, couriers on solar bicycles
world_descriptors.clothing: Practical work wear in natural fibers and earth tones, community robes for ceremonial occasions, Rootstock handwoven textiles, recycled and upcycled fashion statements, solar-powered accessories and tools integrated into garments
world_descriptors.technology: Solar panels seamlessly integrated into every surface, greywater recycling systems, soil testing equipment, seed preservation technology, transparent monitoring systems, solar bicycles and rail, consensus-building communication networks
world_descriptors.lighting: Abundant natural sunlight through smart glass, warm amber evening lighting to preserve circadian rhythms, bioluminescent pathway markers, the green glow of healthy growing things, soft community lighting designed for gathering

visual_identity.visual_exclusions: Dystopian decay, neon-drenched nightscapes, corporate brutalism, weapons and military hardware, pollution and environmental destruction, surveillance state aesthetics, dark oppressive environments
